podcast.title: Arrest for Protesting at PM's House (2002)
podcast.body: In 2002, Otis Ferry was arrested for approaching the Prime Minister's House in the middle of the night to hang pro-hunting posters. "In 2002, he was arrested for approaching the Prime Minister's House in the middle of the night so he can hang pro hunting posters all over the place."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: House of Commons Breach (Fall 2004)
podcast.body: In the fall of 2004, Otis Ferry and seven other fox hunters breached security by barging into the House of Commons to protest anti-hunting legislation. This incident was described as the worst security breach in years, leading to his arrest, a fine, and conditional discharges. "In the fall of 2004, he and seven other fox hunters barged into the House of Commons to protest anti-hunting legislation."

podcast.title: Altercation with PM Tony Blair (Spring 2005)
podcast.body: The following spring, Otis Ferry lunged over a barrier at Prime Minister Tony Blair before being tackled and arrested. "The following spring, Otis lunged over a barrier at PM Tony Blair before he was tackled and arrested."

podcast.title: Drunk Driving Arrest (2005)
podcast.body: A few months after the incident with PM Blair, Otis Ferry was arrested for drunk driving, for which he was fined and released. "A few months later, he was arrested for drunk driving. He was fined and released."

podcast.title: Confrontation with Paparazzi and Arrest (November 2007)
podcast.body: A week after his protest-related arrest, Otis Ferry was arrested again following a confrontation with paparazzi. "A week later, he was arrested again after a confrontation with paparazzi."

podcast.title: Protest Attack and Arrest (November 2007)
podcast.body: In November 2007, he was arrested at another pro-hunt protest after attacking two individuals who were gathering evidence about illegal hunting with hounds. "In November 2007, he was arrested at another pro hunt protest. He attacked two people who were gathering evidence about illegal hunting with hounds."

podcast.title: Robbery, Assault, and Witness Tampering Allegations (April 2008)
podcast.body: In April 2008, he was arrested for robbery and assault, allegedly for again targeting individuals who were seeking evidence of illegal hound hunting. It was further alleged that he attempted to tamper with the case by contacting a key witness to prevent them from testifying against him. "In April of 2008, he was arrested for robbery and assault after again allegedly going after people who were looking for evidence of illegal hound hunting."

podcast.title: Awaiting Trial (March 2009)
podcast.body: As of March 2009, Otis Ferry was awaiting trial in Gloucester Prison for the alleged robbery, assault, and witness tampering charges. "As I write this season, Gloucester Prison, awaiting trial in March of 2009."

podcast.title: Pro Fox Hunting Activist
podcast.body: Charles Frederick Otis Ferry, son of Brian Ferry, is an activist known for his strong support of fox hunting, viewing it as a traditional practice within the United Kingdom. He has actively campaigned against attempts to ban the aristocratic sport in Britain, which considers it cruel and inhumane. "See, Otis loves fox hunting. You know the aristocratic sport of tracking down a poor little fox with a team of horses and a pack of hounds?"

xref.title: Dating Life
xref.body: When Brian Ferry was 61 years old, he dated a 27-year-old model who had previously dated his son, Otis Ferry. "When dad was 61, he dated a 27 year old model. What was interesting was that model once dated Otis."
